William Son of Joel

  Genie: Ah sick is this shark weed? Hell ya. Genies love shark weed. Do you want like, a mansion and a million bucks?
  Narrator: Press 1 to Claim mansion and money.

   Press 1 to Claim mansion and money


## ALRIGHT_WELL_IF_YOU — Carter: Alright well if you're gonna take a nap…

Carter: Alright well if you're gonna take a nap I'll just uh, stand here I guess. You have every right to do this I'm just telling you it's inconsiderate. You fall asleep immediately.

   Press 1 to Go to HELLO_I_M_FRANK

Alright well sorry I have to kill you now.
"And so he does"
Ah well...
"You should try selling me out next time!"

  Narrator: As you both recover from how darned sexy that stork was, you start to notice a change in your surroundings. What was once water and swamp is now trees and grass. You see a large tree with a door that is clearly locked, as well as a dryad ahead of you about to shred total gnar on a massive half-pipe. On the other end of the half-pipe, you see a key hanging on a hook.
  Dryad: "You fellas here to watch me shred total gnar?"
  Narrator: Press 1 to offer him Tony Hawk's helmet, for safety. Press 2 to say nothing and watch, making you complicit in whatever happens next.
  Carter: ooh, that sounds omious

   Press 1 to Offer Helmet
   Press 2 to Say Nothing

  Narrator: As you start to pass through, froggem comes back, with a gun, and shoots you. You are dead.

   Press 2 to Enter Bone House
